## Loading Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(ranger)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(discrim)
library(vctrs)
```


## Sourcing

```{r}

source(here::here("ContextWindows", "ContextWindowFunction.R"))

```


## Setting Seed for Consistent Randomization

```{r}
set.seed(444)
```

## Loading in Data

```{r}


data = read.csv(here::here("TrainingSet", "annotatedMelAW2000-Training.csv")) %>%
  mutate(Humpback = as.factor(Humpback))


data_nooverlap = read.csv(here::here("TrainingSet", "annotatedMelAW2000-Training.csv")) %>%
  mutate(Humpback = as.factor(Humpback)) %>% filter(X %% 2 == 1)

#annotatedMelAW %>% arrange(desc(Time_End))
```


## Creating Training Data

```{r}

trainingdata = add_observations_linear_tolerance(whaledf = data_nooverlap,
                                start_time = 0,
                                end_time = 2000,
                                num_time_steps = 10, 
                                numcep = 12,
                                step_size = 0.1,
                                jump_size = 0.5)

trainingdata %>% select(Time_Start, Time_End, Humpback)



table(trainingdata$Humpback)

trainingdata$Humpback <- relevel(trainingdata$Humpback, ref = 1)
#manual_annotations = read_excel(here::here("OrigData", "AW", "AWhb.xlsx"))
```




## Tuning (Not Saving Predictions)


```{r}
rf_tuning_cv_multi_nopreds <- function(mtry_values = floor(sqrt(ncol(trainingdata) - 3)), 
                                       trees_values = 500, 
                                       min_n_values = 50) {

  training_cvs <- vfold_cv(trainingdata, v = 5)
  
  # custom metric set
  my_metrics <- metric_set(
    precision,
    recall,
    f_meas
  )
  
  # model
  rfmod <- rand_forest(
    mtry = tune(),
    trees = tune(),
    min_n = tune()
  ) %>%
    set_engine("ranger") %>%
    set_mode("classification")
  
  # recipe
  rfrecipe <- recipe(Humpback ~ ., data = trainingdata) %>%
    step_rm(Time_Start, Time_End) %>%
    step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
    step_dummy(all_factor_predictors())
  
  # workflow
  rfworkflow <- workflow() %>%
    add_model(rfmod) %>%
    add_recipe(rfrecipe)
  
  # grid
  rf_grid <- expand_grid(
    mtry = mtry_values,
    trees = trees_values,
    min_n = min_n_values
  )
  
  # tune
  rf_tuned <- rfworkflow %>%
    tune_grid(
      resamples = training_cvs,
      grid = rf_grid,
      metrics = my_metrics,
      control = control_grid(save_pred = FALSE)
    )
  
  # collect metrics
  metrics_f1 <- collect_metrics(rf_tuned)
  

  return(list(
    mtry_values = mtry_values,
    trees_values = trees_values,
    min_n_values = min_n_values,
    tuning_results = rf_tuned,
    metrics_f1 = metrics_f1
  ))
}
```


```{r}

results2 <- rf_tuning_cv_multi_nopreds(mtry_values = floor(sqrt(ncol(trainingdata)) - 3),
                                       trees_values = c(250, 500),
                                       min_n_values = 50)

metric_set = results2$metrics_f1 %>% select(mtry, trees, min_n, .metric, mean) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = .metric,
    values_from = mean) %>% select(mtry, trees, min_n, recall, precision, f_meas) %>%
  rename(F1 = f_meas)# precision, recall, F1

```
